cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Approve the Cover Story
cards.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Can you approve 'delivery delay' in the newsletter? I don't want our new volunteer blamed for the melted cake. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She delivered it on time. We left it by the radiator.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then 'storage problem'. Will you approve that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if we mention the refund.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. 'Storage problem; full refund arranged.' Can I put your name under it?

mechanism: A directs a newsletter and changes a protective explanation around B factual correction and refund condition to obtain B named approval.
confusable: Unlike privately excusing a mistake, A seeks endorsement of public wording; the Stance pays a practical cost and adopts a corrected account to keep B signing.
comparison: A volunteer reputation and customer compensation differ from maintaining access to a hall.
seedUse: D124-b melted cake, radiator and refund; S02-b adapts the proposed method to B requirements.
